source: intended: docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut" (build save asks on a terminal or takes --yes): a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK, which is a terminal answer or --yes; the guard denies the agent
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). `build save` reads only `.jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml`: an id with no draft is `JITSO REJECTED: no draft "<id>"`; an id that is not kebab-case (a path, for example) is `JITSO REJECTED: build id must be kebab-case` and is never turned into a path; no id is `JITSO REJECTED: build save needs a draft id`; any other word is an unknown argument. All exit 2 with nothing on stdout.
